text: じゃあ　つれて　おかえり！

structure.en: take it along and go home!

patterns.name: お〜なさい
patterns.explanation: お plus the short stem of a verb is a gentle order, short for お〜なさい, used by older people to younger ones. おかえり = 'go on home'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next; here it shows you go home while bringing it along. つれて　おかえり = 'take it home with you'.
